exceptions.reason: The unsound VariantStrIter API is not referenced by Mendimaru source or by any crate in the locked graph that depends on glib 0.18.5; the crate remains a transitive Tauri/WebKitGTK dependency because no Tauri/wry release supports glib >=0.20 yet.

reachability.evidence: 2026-10-12 follow-up review (#228/#231): Cargo metadata reverse-dependency closure of glib 0.18.5 contains 23 packages including Mendimaru. No VariantStrIter, variant_str_iter or array_iter_str reference occurs in their Rust sources at the checked commit (Mendimaru, atk, cairo-rs, gdk, gdk-pixbuf, gdkx11, gio, gtk, javascriptcore-rs, libappindicator, muda, pango, soup3, tao, tauri, tauri-runtime, tauri-runtime-wry, tauri-plugin-dialog, tauri-plugin-fs, tauri-plugin-opener, tray-icon, webkit2gtk and wry). Inside glib 0.18.5 array_iter_str() is used only by its own tests. Latest tauri 2.12.3, wry 0.57.0 and webkit2gtk 2.0.2 still require gtk/glib 0.18.

exceptions.remediationPlan: Upgrade glib to >=0.20 through Tauri/wry as soon as a release drops gtk 0.18/webkit2gtk 2.0 (tauri 2.12.3, wry 0.57.0 and webkit2gtk 2.0.2 still require glib 0.18 on 2026-10-12); remove this exception immediately if a source reference to VariantStrIter or array_iter_str is introduced.
